isabel (PM): Quick sync: MegaBank asked for tenant-owned keys + a selective 5y audit lane (only audit_logs + evidence). They also want a documented emergency retention extension (escape hatch). Can we scope a pilot?

nikhil (security): High level: doable, but need KMS binding docs, export integrity (signed manifest + checksums), and legal hold semantics. Legal must sign off before GA. :lock:

claire (eng-infra): Tech notes: we should treat archival as cold objects and keep a tiny index for export lookups. Full-text search on 5y would be too expensive. API idea: PATCH /v1/tenants/:tid/retention {"tier":"archival","scopes":["audit_logs","evidence"]} (pilot: support-only).

samir (ops): Escape hatch flow proposal: support ticket -> verify customer admin signature -> SRE approval -> set temp_extension (<=30d) -> schedule auto-revert. Record approval hash in audit stream.

emma (sales): Procurement asks for a one-pager showing attestation steps + export SLA. Customer will pay for UI if we aim GA eventually.

audit-bot: evidence-export task queued: tenant MegaBank, job id 7102, status pending approval.

isabel (PM): Open decisions: (1) pilot mode (support-only) or self-serve? (2) billing: onboarding flat fee + per-GB archive vs flat price band? (3) extension policy: max days and approval model.

nikhil (security): Minimum pilot gates: (A) attestation checklist delivered to customer, (B) signed export manifests with sha256, (C) retention-change audit trail. No BYOK GA until legal/HSM attestation done.

claire (eng-infra): CLI stub for export we'll provide to ops:
```
redwood export --tenant TMBK --scope evidence --from 2020-01-01 --to 2025-01-01 --out /tmp/megabank-evidence.tar.gz
```
Export manifest should include: file list, sha256 checksums, key IDs, signed-by (service), timestamp.

samir (ops): Runbook items: verify-keystore-ownership, capture approval hash, run export job, validate checksums, deliver bundle to customer. Add on-call play for failed checksum.

emma (sales): Can we offer a 12-month capped archival spend for pilot? Customer requests price cap.

claire (eng-infra): We can support a billing cap flag that triggers alerts + blocks writes if exceeded. Requires billing pipeline change but ok for pilot as contractual override.

isabel (PM): Proposed pilot MVP: - Manual BYOK onboarding (support-driven) - Support-only retention flips (temporary <=30d) - Export bundles with signed manifest + sha256 - Billing: onboarding fee + per-GB/month archival, optional 12-month cap by contract - Runbook + attestation checklist. Launch gates: security attestation, legal signoff, ops runbook, cost estimate reviewed.

nikhil (security): Add legal_hold flag to model: when set, prevent deletes/auto-reverts. Must be auditable and require authorized principal to clear.

samir (ops): Suggest approval UX: customer admin uploads signed approval PDF -> we hash and store hash in audit log before change. Also require 2 SRE approvals for emergency extensions.

emma (sales): I'll draft the procurement one-pager and pricing scenarios once PM posts the manifest template.

isabel (PM): Action items: claire -> storage + cost estimate EOW; nikhil -> attestation checklist Tue; samir -> runbook skeleton Wed; emma -> one-pager Thu. Pilot timeline: Q2 support-only pilot; aim Q3 self-serve if gates met.

audit-bot: job 7102 moved to awaiting-runbook state.

ikhil (security): Note: export SLO for pilot = 48h; GA target = 12h. Document in checklist.

isabel (PM): Perfect. I'll open a feature ticket and tag owners. Thanks all. :v:
